pairs.evidence: src/components/flow-composer/components/FlowNodes.tsx:38 Every node, every node's remove control and every wire's remove control is its own tab stop inside an SVG with no role or name, and dragging is the only way to move a node; this is the per-node and per-edge tab wall the standard names as a failure, and there is no non-pointer move path.

techniques.evidence: src/components/flow-composer/components/FlowNodes.tsx:38 One tab stop per node, plus one per remove button (FlowNodes.tsx:108) and one per wire (FlowWires.tsx:65). The <svg> in index.tsx has no role or accessible name, there is no roving focus, and there is no keyboard nudge for x position (drag is pointer-only).

src/components/flow-composer/use-flow-composer.ts:111 The drag starts at pointerdown, and the model is mutated on the first pointermove with no screen-space movement threshold. After pointerup clears dragNode, the trailing click still reaches handleNodeClick and can start wiring. Pointer capture is taken on e.target (index.tsx:145), and there is no pointercancel or lostpointercapture handler. There is no undo.

src/components/flow-composer/components/FlowWires.tsx:27 Edge identity is the (from,to) pair: the Wire type has no id, and removeWire filters on from/to, which is the identity scheme the technique names as broken. Node geometry is also restated separately in FlowNodes (y from PRODUCER_Y/CONSUMER_Y), in NodeConnectors, and in nodePos+NODE_R in FlowWires, instead of coming from one geometry function.

src/components/flow-composer/data.ts:80 Positions persist in the URL hash and are keyed by durable node id (good). The document has no version field, though, and a decode failure silently falls back to DEFAULT_NODES with no visible degradation. addNode places a node at last+18 clamped to 92, so new nodes can stack on each other.

src/components/flow-composer/components/FlowWires.tsx:50 Each wire runs an infinite ambient animation while the surface is idle. There is no population gate (the wire count is user-unbounded) and no visibility pause; only reduced motion stops it. Drag commits are rAF-throttled (use-flow-composer.ts:108), but FlowNodes is not memoized and receives inline callbacks rebuilt on every render.

src/components/flow-composer/use-flow-composer.ts:96 There is no camera. The forward mapping is the SVG viewBox, but the inverse (toSvgX) is derived by hand from VB_W in the gesture hook, with a 8..92 clamp the forward mapping lacks, instead of coming from the projection (e.g. getScreenCTM). No round-trip test exists: data.test.ts covers only decodeFlow.
